name: @local/market-lens
description: DSH plugin market radar: aggregates 1024Store, dshfind, dsh.so, dshmarketplace and custom catalogs, checks DSH runtime compatibility from npm metadata, and offers Excel-like filtering in real desktop-style windows, resizable columns, scheduled refresh, installed-plugin update checks that never probe local/link installs, per-sync change badges, a security-first view, persistent page state, a runtime operation log for install troubleshooting, importable/exportable source config, and a scoring-rule library with dropdown selection and a documented template.
author: Kewei Chen <wodaimnd@users.noreply.github.com>
